title: Could robots replace us at work
titleChinese: 机器人能代替我们工作吗？
paragraphs: If you’re in a job performing tedious tasks, you might think that a robot could do the work instead. But perhaps we underestimate how much technology already helps with the activities that we would otherwise have to do. And as artificial intelligence progresses we might find it replaces us in the workplace altogether.

For now, robotic technology is providing a helping hand for businesses, particularly in manufacturing, assisting humans in performing work more efficiently and sometimes more accurately. For online shopping, for example, robots have become essential in giant warehouses. They sort and move millions of objects of all different shapes and sizes, although humans are still needed to pick and distribute the goods.

The advancement of robotics in the workplace is good for some businesses; the ones who research, develop, build and use them. The British government estimates that by 2035, artificial intelligence could add around £630bn to the UK economy. But there are still tasks that robots can’t yet do, and that’s the challenge for companies such as Automata. Its co-founder, Suryansh Chandra, told the BBC that his technology will eliminate boring, repetitive jobs that humans don't like and aren't very good at, and also create new ones that are likely to replace them.

It seems inevitable that robots will eventually be able to do more and more of the jobs that are currently performed by humans, so should we be worried by the rise of the machines? Some experts fear hundreds of thousands of jobs could disappear as robots replace human workers. A report by the OECD suggests that 14% of jobs are "at high risk of automation" and 32% of jobs could be "radically transformed", with the manufacturing sector at the highest risk.
But as complete automation is some way off, for now we’ll have to work side-by-side with our robot colleagues - and manage to get along with them before they learn to kick us out of the door!

vocabulary.entry: tedious /ˈtiːdiəs/ adj. 枯燥乏味的；冗长的
vocabulary.example: The job involves a lot of tedious data entry.
vocabulary.translation: 这份工作需要做大量枯燥的数据录入工作。

vocabulary.entry: underestimate /ˌʌndərˈestɪmeɪt/ v. 低估；看轻
vocabulary.example: Don’t underestimate the time it will take to finish the project.
vocabulary.translation: 别低估完成这个项目需要的时间。

vocabulary.entry: artificial intelligence /ˌɑːtɪfɪʃl ɪnˈtelɪdʒəns/ 人工智能
vocabulary.example: Artificial intelligence is changing the way we live and work.
vocabulary.translation: 人工智能正在改变我们的生活和工作方式。

vocabulary.entry: progress /ˈprəʊɡres/ v. 发展；进步
vocabulary.example: Medical technology is progressing at a rapid pace.
vocabulary.translation: 医疗技术正在飞速发展。

vocabulary.entry: robotic technology /rəʊˈbɒtɪk tekˈnɒlədʒi/ 机器人技术
vocabulary.example: Robotic technology has made great strides in the past decade.
vocabulary.translation: 过去十年间，机器人技术取得了巨大进步。

vocabulary.entry: manufacturing /ˌmænjuˈfæktʃərɪŋ/ n. 制造业；生产业
vocabulary.example: The region is known for its car manufacturing industry.
vocabulary.translation: 该地区以汽车制造业闻名。

vocabulary.entry: efficiently /ɪˈfɪʃntli/ adv. 高效地；有效地
vocabulary.example: We need to work more efficiently to meet the deadline.
vocabulary.translation: 我们需要更高效地工作以赶上截止日期。

vocabulary.entry: accurately /ˈækjərətli/ adv. 精准地；准确地
vocabulary.example: The machine can measure the dimensions accurately.
vocabulary.translation: 这台机器能精准测量尺寸。

vocabulary.entry: giant warehouses /ˈdʒaɪənt ˈweəhaʊsɪz/ 大型仓库
vocabulary.example: Giant warehouses are needed to store goods for online shopping.
vocabulary.translation: 网购商品的储存需要用到大型仓库。

vocabulary.entry: sort /sɔːt/ v. 分拣；整理
vocabulary.example: The workers sort the packages by destination every morning.
vocabulary.translation: 工人们每天早上按目的地分拣包裹。

vocabulary.entry: distribute /dɪˈstrɪbjuːt/ v. 配送；分发
vocabulary.example: The company distributes its products to stores across the country.
vocabulary.translation: 这家公司把产品配送到全国各地的门店。

vocabulary.entry: advancement /ədˈvɑːnsmənt/ n. 发展；进步
vocabulary.example: The advancement of science has brought many benefits to humanity.
vocabulary.translation: 科学的发展为人类带来了诸多益处。

vocabulary.entry: eliminate /ɪˈlɪmɪneɪt/ v. 省去；消除
vocabulary.example: The new software will eliminate the need for manual data entry.
vocabulary.translation: 这款新软件将省去手动录入数据的环节。

vocabulary.entry: repetitive /rɪˈpetətɪv/ adj. 重复性的；反复的
vocabulary.example: Repetitive work can be very tiring for the mind and body.
vocabulary.translation: 重复性工作会让人身心俱疲。

vocabulary.entry: inevitable /ɪnˈevɪtəbl/ adj. 不可避免的；必然发生的
vocabulary.example: Change is inevitable in a fast-paced world.
vocabulary.translation: 在快节奏的世界里，变化是不可避免的。

vocabulary.entry: currently /ˈkʌrəntli/ adv. 当前；目前
vocabulary.example: The company is currently developing a new product line.
vocabulary.translation: 该公司目前正在开发一条新的产品线。

vocabulary.entry: at high risk of automation /æt haɪ rɪsk ɒv ˌɔːtəˈmeɪʃn/ 面临极高自动化风险
vocabulary.example: Manual assembly jobs are at high risk of automation.
vocabulary.translation: 手工装配岗位面临极高的自动化风险。

vocabulary.entry: radically transformed /ˈrædɪkli trænsˈfɔːmd/ 被彻底改变
vocabulary.example: The industry has been radically transformed by digital technology.
vocabulary.translation: 数字技术彻底改变了这个行业。

vocabulary.entry: complete automation /kəmˈpliːt ˌɔːtəˈmeɪʃn/ 全面自动化
vocabulary.example: Complete automation in agriculture is still a long way off.
vocabulary.translation: 农业的全面自动化还有很长的路要走。

vocabulary.entry: side-by-side /ˌsaɪd baɪ ˈsaɪd/ adv. 并肩地；一起
vocabulary.example: The two teams worked side-by-side to finish the project on time.
vocabulary.translation: 两支团队并肩合作，按时完成了项目。

vocabulary.entry: get along with /ɡet əˈlɒŋ wɪð/ 和睦相处；融洽相处
vocabulary.example: It’s important to get along with your colleagues in the workplace.
vocabulary.translation: 在职场中，与同事和睦相处很重要。

vocabulary.term: kick us out of the door
vocabulary.entry: kick us out of the door /kɪk əs aʊt ɒv ðə dɔː/ 把我们扫地出门（俚语）
vocabulary.example: If we don’t improve our performance, the boss might kick us out of the door.
vocabulary.translation: 要是我们不提升工作表现，老板可能会把我们扫地出门。

sentences.english: If you’re in a job performing tedious tasks, you might think that a robot could do the work instead.
sentences.chinese: 如果你从事的工作需要完成大量枯燥的任务，你或许会觉得这些活完全可以交给机器人来做。

sentences.english: But perhaps we underestimate how much technology already helps with the activities that we would otherwise have to do.
sentences.chinese: 但我们可能低估了技术已经帮我们做了许多我们不得不自己做的事情。

sentences.english: And as artificial intelligence progresses we might find it replaces us in the workplace altogether.
sentences.chinese: 而且随着人工智能的不断发展，我们甚至可能会发现，它将会在各种场景中彻底取代人类。

sentences.english: For now, robotic technology is providing a helping hand for businesses, particularly in manufacturing, assisting humans in performing work more efficiently and sometimes more accurately.
sentences.chinese: 目前，机器人技术正在为各类企业提供助力，尤其是在制造业领域，它能帮助人类更高效、有时甚至更精准地完成工作。

sentences.english: For online shopping, for example, robots have become essential in giant warehouses.
sentences.chinese: 以网购为例，机器人在大型仓库里已经成了必不可少的存在。

sentences.english: They sort and move millions of objects of all different shapes and sizes, although humans are still needed to pick and distribute the goods.
sentences.chinese: 它们负责分拣和搬运数百万件形状、大小各异的商品，不过拣选和配送货物的工作仍然需要人类来完成。

sentences.english: The advancement of robotics in the workplace is good for some businesses; the ones who research, develop, build and use them.
sentences.chinese: 在工作场所中，机器人技术的发展对部分企业来说是利好消息，也就是那些从事机器人研发、制造和使用的企业。

sentences.english: The British government estimates that by 2035, artificial intelligence could add around £630bn to the UK economy.
sentences.chinese: 英国政府估计，到2035年，人工智能将为英国经济贡献约6300亿英镑的产值。

sentences.english: But there are still tasks that robots can’t yet do, and that’s the challenge for companies such as Automata.
sentences.chinese: 但仍有一些任务是机器人目前无法完成的，这也是奥托马塔这类公司面临的挑战。

sentences.english: Its co-founder, Suryansh Chandra, told the BBC that his technology will eliminate boring, repetitive jobs that humans don't like and aren't very good at, and also create new ones that are likely to replace them.
sentences.chinese: 该公司联合创始人苏里亚尚·钱德拉在接受BBC采访时表示，他们的技术将省去那些人类不喜欢、也并不擅长的枯燥重复性工作，同时还会创造出一些很可能会取代原有岗位的新工作。

sentences.english: It seems inevitable that robots will eventually be able to do more and more of the jobs that are currently performed by humans, so should we be worried by the rise of the machines?
sentences.chinese: 机器人最终将能承担越来越多目前由人类完成的工作，这似乎是不可避免的趋势，那么我们是否应该为机器的崛起而担忧呢？

sentences.english: Some experts fear hundreds of thousands of jobs could disappear as robots replace human workers.
sentences.chinese: 一些专家担心，随着机器人取代人类劳动者，数十万个工作岗位可能会消失。

sentences.english: A report by the OECD suggests that 14% of jobs are "at high risk of automation" and 32% of jobs could be "radically transformed", with the manufacturing sector at the highest risk.
sentences.chinese: 经济合作与发展组织的一份报告指出，14%的工作岗位“面临极高的自动化风险”，32%的工作岗位可能会“被彻底改变”，其中制造业面临的风险最大。

sentences.english: But as complete automation is some way off, for now we’ll have to work side-by-side with our robot colleagues - and manage to get along with them before they learn to kick us out of the door!
sentences.chinese: 不过，全面自动化的实现还有一段距离，目前我们还得和机器人同事并肩作战——而且得在它们学会把我们扫地出门之前，努力和它们和睦相处！
